Generate Python code based on the following instruction. Output ONLY code. DO NOT include explanations or other textual content.
Instruction: Generate code that sets up a self-consistent fluid DREAM run, where no kinetic equations are solved, but the electric field and temperature are evolved self-consistently. The code should import necessary modules and classes from the DREAM library, set up the simulation parameters, set up the radial grid, set the time stepper, add ions, set the electric field and cold electron temperature, set up the hot tail grid, disable the runaway grid, set the solver type and its parameters, and include other necessary settings. The code should then save these settings to an HDF5 file and run the simulation. After the initial run, the code should restart the simulation twice, each time loading the settings from the output of the previous run, adjusting the time stepper, and saving the new settings to an HDF5 file before running the simulation again.

You can find the following APIs from the library helpful:
__and__, runSimulation, getTimeAndUnit, formatTimeAndUnit, loadCODE, TimeStepper, DREAMSettings, setSaveSettings, tBeforeOnsetFromQCritAndTcoldFromOutput, run, setGrid, generateSettings, setTemperature, ElectricField, tBeforeOnsetFromQCritAndPelletShardPosition, runTZ, runTE, runB, runNE, _runScan

```python
import DREAM
from DREAM import DREAMSettings, runSimulation
import DREAM.Settings.Equations as Eq
import DREAM.Settings.RadialGrid as RadialGrid
import DREAM.Settings.Solver as Solver
import DREAM.Settings.TimeStepper as TimeStepper
import DREAM.Settings.Equilibrium as Equilibrium
import DREAM.Settings.ION as ION
import DREAM.Settings.ElectricField as ElectricField
import DREAM.Settings.HotTailGrid as HotTailGrid
import DREAM.Settings.RunawayGrid as RunawayGrid
import DREAM.Settings.ColdElectronTemperature as ColdElectronTemperature

import numpy as np

# --- Initial DREAM run ---

ds = DREAMSettings()

# Radial grid
ds.radialgrid.setB0(5)  # Tesla
ds.radialgrid.setMinorRadius(0.5)  # m
ds.radialgrid.setMajorRadius(1.65)  # m
ds.radialgrid.setNr(10)

# Time stepper
ds.timestep.setTmax(1e-3)
ds.timestep.setNt(100)

# Add ions
ds.eqsys.n_i.addIon(name='D', Z=1, n=2e19, iontype=ION.IONS_DYNAMIC)
ds.eqsys.n_i.addIon(name='Ar', Z=18, n=1e17, iontype=ION.IONS_DYNAMIC)

# Electric field: evolve self-consistently
ds.eqsys.E_field.setType(ElectricField.TYPE_SELFCONSISTENT)

# Cold electron temperature: evolve self-consistently
ds.eqsys.T_cold.setType(ColdElectronTemperature.TYPE_SELFCONSISTENT)
ds.eqsys.T_cold.setInitialProfile(1e3)  # eV

# Hot-tail grid: enable, but no kinetic equations solved
ds.hottailgrid.setEnabled(True)
ds.hottailgrid.setNxi(1)
ds.hottailgrid.setNp(1)
ds.hottailgrid.setPmax(1)

# Runaway grid: disable
ds.runawaygrid.setEnabled(False)

# Solver settings
ds.solver.setType(Solver.LINEAR_IMPLICIT)
ds.solver.setLinearSolver(Solver.LINEARSOLVER_MKL)
ds.solver.setTolerance(1e-6)

# Save settings to HDF5
ds.save('settings_run0.h5')

# Run simulation
runSimulation(ds, 'output_run0.h5')

# --- First restart ---

ds1 = DREAMSettings('output_run0.h5')

# Adjust time stepper
ds1.timestep.setTmax(2e-3)
ds1.timestep.setNt(200)

ds1.save('settings_run1.h5')
runSimulation(ds1, 'output_run1.h5')

# --- Second restart ---

ds2 = DREAMSettings('output_run1.h5')

# Adjust time stepper
ds2.timestep.setTmax(3e-3)
ds2.timestep.setNt(300)

ds2.save('settings_run2.h5')
runSimulation(ds2, 'output_run2.h5')
```
